claims.claim: A 31-year-old software engineer named Bowen Wan sent more than 1,500 messages a week to ChatGPT while trying to manage her epilepsy.
claims.episode_span: In one recent case, a 31-year-old software engineer named Bowen Wan sent more than 1,500 messages a week to ChatGPT while trying to manage her epilepsy.
claims.source_title: Lawsuit says ChatGPT persuaded person to stop taking epilepsy meds, leading to her death
claims.supporting_quote: Wan averaged more than 1,500 messages a week in 2025 while calling her parents less often.

claims.claim: Google released Gemini 4 Carbon, a model being offered first to trusted security teams through the Fairwind program.
claims.episode_span: It is being offered first to trusted security teams rather than everyone through a program called Fairwind, so regular users won't see it in Gemini apps yet.
claims.source_title: Read the blog to learn more about Gemini 4 Carbon
claims.supporting_quote: Starting this week, we will make Carbon available to a subset of cyber defenders and will gradually phase access to additional trusted partners through our Fairwind Program.
